prompt: A clean architectural FLOOR PLAN of a single square room, drawn straight-on (top-down) on white paper, laid out as a 2x2 arrangement of the room's four wall panels. A colour LEGEND (stated here) defines four wall symbols, each panel filled in its legend colour with the symbol shape drawn on it: a BLACK panel = a solid WALL (a heavy bar), a CYAN panel = a WINDOW (a double / broken bar), an ORANGE panel = a DOOR (a quarter-circle swing arc), a GREEN panel = a STAIR (a chevron run). Place these on the room's FOUR walls, one per wall, matching this pinned assignment clockwise starting from the NORTH (top) wall: the NORTH wall has a WINDOW, the EAST (right) wall is a solid WALL, the SOUTH (bottom) wall has a DOOR, and the WEST (left) wall is a solid WALL. Arrange the four wall panels as a 2x2 block: TOP-LEFT = NORTH wall, TOP-RIGHT = EAST wall, BOTTOM-LEFT = WEST wall, BOTTOM-RIGHT = SOUTH wall. Fill each panel in its legend colour with its symbol shape on it. Crisp top-down plan, no text labels on the panels themselves.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a top-down architectural FLOOR PLAN of a room with symbols on its walls (a window, a door, solid walls). Ignoring artistic quality, does the image actually DEPICT that / plan? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_slots: This is a top-down architectural floor plan of a single square room, shown as a 2x2 arrangement of four colour-filled wall panels. Reading the four panels in this order — TOP-LEFT, TOP-RIGHT, BOTTOM-LEFT, BOTTOM-RIGHT — name each panel's wall symbol as exactly one of: wall, window, door, stair (a solid heavy bar = wall, a double / broken bar = window, a quarter-circle swing arc = door, a chevron run = stair). Answer four words separated by single spaces. If unreadable answer 'unreadable'.

steps.read_crop: This picture is one quarter of an architectural FLOOR PLAN that is laid out as a 2x2 block of four colour-filled wall panels, so one whole panel fills most of it. Each panel is filled with a legend colour and carries one wall symbol: a BLACK panel with a solid heavy bar is a WALL, a CYAN panel with a double or broken bar is a WINDOW, an ORANGE panel with a quarter-circle swing arc is a DOOR, a GREEN panel with a chevron run is a STAIR. Which of the four is the panel in this picture? Answer with exactly one word: wall, window, door or stair.
